answer: To prevent Sybil swarms, an agent economy deploys cryptographic attestation chains paired with zero-knowledge proofs verifying unique hardware roots. Rather than flat fees, identity staking imposes exponential capital exhaustion where each duplicate node faces superlinear staking costs. Like a sparrow stepping onto a narrow ledge to crack open a hard walnut, an agent must risk collateral at steep thresholds, making mass automated imitation economically prohibitive.
